title: Compactification-specific affine-space ambient adjunction
statement: For finite torsion coefficients A killed by N and a Noetherian base S on which N is invertible, the derived lower shriek attached to any compactification c of the affine-space projection is left adjoint to the explicit finite Tate-twist pullback followed by the shift [2d].

proof.text: Carry out the affine-line/projective-line induction for the specified compactification and identify the iterated right functor with the finite Tate-twist pullback and even shift.

proof_origin.place: Affine-line induction before transport to the chosen compactification

lean.statement: theorem affineSpaceAmbientAdjunction_of_compactification (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0) (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) (c : Compactification (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ↘ S)) : Nonempty (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ⊣ ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S ↘ S)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ derivedTensorRight (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateTwist (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) S) N A hA d))) ⋙ shiftFunctor _ (2 * (d : ℤ)))
